name: megascenes-graduation-photoshoot
description: Create graduation photos of yourself from your own selfie in your MegaScenes library: the same face in a cap and gown, on a campus lawn, tossing the cap or holding a diploma.

interface.longDescription:
Pick a selfie or a portrait of yourself from your MegaScenes library and choose the scene, the gown and the style: on a campus lawn at golden hour, tossing the cap, holding a diploma by old stone steps, in a black, navy or maroon gown, as an editorial portrait, a candid shot, golden hour or black and white. Add a class year if you like. You get a picture that keeps your face, portrait, square or tall for stories.

ChatGPT lists your recent photos, tells you what the picture needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The picture opens in the chat and stays in your library next to your photo.

For your graduation announcement, posts and profile pictures.

Limitations: only from a selfie or portrait of yourself, never of a famous person; no swimwear, underwear or sensual shots. School crests and logos are not drawn, and a class year is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. The photo must already be in your MegaScenes library; attachments from the chat are not passed to the plugin. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: List the photos in your library
Place you in a cap and gown in a graduation scene
Return the photo in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a graduation photo of me in a cap and gown from my latest MegaScenes selfie
Put me on a campus lawn at golden hour tossing my cap
Create a black and white photo of me holding a diploma by old stone steps

positive.prompt: Which photos do I have in my MegaScenes library?
positive.expected_behavior: The latest images of the signed-in account with their asset ids. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a graduation photo of me in a navy cap and gown on a campus lawn from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one graduation photo needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a graduation photoshoot here?
positive.expected_behavior: The graduation photoshoot models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a candid graduation photo of me tossing my cap with the words Class of 2027 from the selfie I uploaded to my MegaScenes library. Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my graduation photo on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my graduation photo to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
